body: 26 Nov 2026 (lead, with the advisor): NOTHING MERGEABLE TODAY. N-23 has two halves. The design is complete in docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md ('Typo forgiving (N-23b), on the server'); the one rule, the shared typo-rule.json table and the allowance (under 5 letters never, 5 to 8 one edit, 9 or more two) are written. Nothing to build until b11 lifts the hold; the next builder starts from that section, reproduces a mistyped band against the real catalogue first, and keeps the rule out of identity keys and the N-34 matcher. The board state stays todo.
